verdict: The distribution point was reachable but did not hold the requested content. The content was never distributed or distribution is incomplete.
fix: In the console, open the package or application and check `Content Status`. Redistribute to the target DP (or the DP group) if the status is `Failed`, `In Progress`, or missing. If the content source path on the site server is unreachable (wrong UNC, permissions), distribution will keep failing until the source is fixed.
